name: SubgrantDisbursementManager
tagline: Partner subgrants in tranches – conditions, approvals, payments, holdback and reports in one app.
description: A complete subgranting app for NGOs and foundations in one Power Apps component: awards to implementing partners split into tranches, conditions-precedent checklists, approval with dual approval, segregation of duties and a report gate, payments net of holdback, partner report review, holdback release, a drag-and-drop disbursement board, award timelines and a disbursement forecast. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Tranche schedules per award with timeline
Conditions precedent checklist with automatic status
Report gate: next tranche only after the report is accepted
Dual approval and segregation of duties
Payments net of holdback, unique payment references
Holdback release when the award closes
Partner report tracking with on-time rate
Payment run file (CSV) of approved tranches
Bulk approve / assign / export, undo, audit history
Demo mode with 16 fictional awards and 44 tranches
